messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: prod-inference — elevated 5xx rate and token latency spike detected for inference-shard-3. Pager runbook: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/prod-inference>. Please acknowledge and post initial findings.

maria: ack, I'm oncall. starting triage — looking at runtime metrics and logs.
maria: initial read: KV cache miss ratio jumped from 4% to 62% at ~17:03 UTC, concurrent latency p95 increased from 120ms -> 950ms.

ajay: pinging in. any obvious memory pressure or OOMs?
maria: no OOMs in the worker nodes, but I see frequent KV lookup timeouts (RPC timeout). stack traces show "kv.lookup timeout" and repeated kv rekey attempts.

sara: looping in infra team — can you capture a short span of logs + heap stats and paste? customers may be affected, do we have impacted API keys?
eva: I can pull impacted keys from the analytics pipeline. quick numbers: ~6% of requests in US-East saw 5xx, estimated 120k requests in last 15m. customer tier breakdown attached in dashboard link: <https://redwood.internal/dash/incident/1823345566>.

maria: capturing logs now. snippet:
```
[17:03:12.324] inference-runtime: kv.lookup timeout key_prefix="/kv/prefix/ctx" err="deadline exceeded" shard=3
[17:03:12.325] inference-runtime: falling back to cold model load; increased token generation time
[17:03:13.110] inference-runtime: batching flush triggered early -> inflight=24 target=64
```

derek: this looks like KV backend throttling + batching interactions. Two-pronged mitigation: 1) reduce batch size target so requests don't wait for large batches, 2) temporarily bypass KV prefix for non-sensitive flows, 3) increase KV client timeouts as short-term bandaid. I can push a controlled change to service config.
maria: agreed. I'll do a small config bump: set batch_target=8 -> 4 for shard-3 and change kv_timeout=500ms -> 1200ms. rolling deploy to shard-3 only.

ajay: I'm going to revert the most recent quantized model rollout on shard-3. hypothesis: quantized variant increases KV memory fragmentation causing higher lookup latency under load. revert to v2.1_f32.
maria: executing mitigations now:
- deploy config change to shard-3 (batch_target=4, kv_timeout=1200ms)
- trigger model rollback to v2.1_f32 for shard-3
- if latencies don't improve, flush KV prefix for session state cache

maria: command I ran:
```bash
# adjust runtime config via ops api
curl -XPOST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  https://infra.api.redwood/v1/runtime/shards/3/config \
  -d '{"batch_target":4, "kv_timeout_ms":1200}'

# rollback model
/cicd deploy --service=inference --shard=3 --image=registry/redwood/inference:v2.1_f32 --reason="rollback quantized suspect"
```

ops-bot: config change applied to shard-3 (deploy id: cfg-7732). model rollback triggered (deploy id: deploy-7791).

maria: after changes, p95 dropped to 220ms and 5xx rate back to 1.2% within 3 minutes. KV miss ratio down to ~8%. Good short-term.

sara: nice work. customer impact: eva, please draft an incident summary for CS with affected customers list and ETA for full resolution.
eva: on it, sharing list in #support in 15m.

ajay: follow-ups we should track: root cause RCA for KV eviction behavior under quantized memory layout, evaluate model memory footprint metrics, and add a safety gate to future quantized rollouts.
derek: also add an automated autoscaling hook when KV latency crosses threshold, and an alert to detect rapid KV miss ratio jumps (noisy neighbor pattern).

maria: scheduling post-incident review: propose tomorrow 10:00 PT — bring runtime, infra, model-ops, and QA. Sara, can you set the invite and capture action items?
sara: scheduled: 2026-03-16 10:00 PT, calendar invite sent to runtime@, infra@, model-ops@. I've added a gist for notes: <https://redwood.internal/notes/INC-1823345566>.

maria: immediate action items (assigned):
- A1: Full KV RPC trace for 17:00-17:10 UTC (ajay) — due 72h
- A2: Memory allocator and quantized model footprint analysis (ajay + model-ops) — due 5 days
- A3: Add rollout safety gate for quantized variants: fail if KV latency increases >20% during canary (derek) — due 3 days
- A4: Add KV miss-ratio Spike alert and automated batching fallback (maria) — due 48h
- A5: Customer communication draft for CS (eva) — due 2h

ajay: acknowledged A1/A2. I'll upload traces to the shared RCA folder and start digging into allocator logs.
derek: I'll open PR for rollout safety gate and the alert rule, link will be posted here when ready.

maria: tagging follow-up board: <https://redwood.internal/boards/rca/1823345566>. please add PR links and notes there.

sara: final notes: temporary mitigations rolled back? we left shard-3 on stable v2.1_f32 and batch_target=4. plan is to revert batch_target back to 8 after we validate KV behavior under canary.

oncall-bot: Incident declared resolved: severity=partial-mitigation, mitigation_time=17:07 UTC, resolution_time=17:10 UTC. Postmortem owner: ajay.

maria: thanks everyone. closing on-call here, handing to ajay for RCA. I'll update the incident doc with timestamps and commands used. :wave:

ajay: taking over RCA, will follow up in the postmortem.

ops-bot: Action items logged in task tracker: TASK-1129, TASK-1130, TASK-1131, TASK-1132, TASK-1133.

sara: thanks team — please add any additional notes or follow-ups to the postmortem doc.
